steps.title: Analyze the Database Persistence bug
steps.description: Examine the current implementation to understand why user-created databases and schemas are not persisting across app restarts.

steps.title: Implement SharedPreferences active database storage
steps.description: Add code to persist the active database name using Android SharedPreferences when a database is switched or created.

steps.title: Restore active database on app start
steps.description: Update MainActivity onCreate to read the persisted active database name from SharedPreferences and open it automatically.

steps.title: Ensure database open operations are non-destructive
steps.description: Verify that openOrCreateDatabase is called in a way that preserves existing tables and records.

steps.title: Ensure database lists are loaded from persistent storage
steps.description: Ensure listDatabases properly scans the internal databases directory to list all user-created databases.

steps.title: Verify query history persistence
steps.description: Ensure the system database query log remains intact across app launches to track executions correctly.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 compatibility
steps.description: Review the changed codebase to guarantee strict compatibility with Java 8 runtimes, avoiding lambdas or streams.

steps.title: Ensure safe XML manifest namespace declaration
steps.description: Double check AndroidManifest.xml namespace properties to prevent Gradle XML attribute validation warnings.

steps.title: Perform overall code verification
steps.description: Verify that all editor, schema parser, search filter, and export features are working without regression.

steps.title: Building SQL Database Manager
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final debug APK using AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.
